categories.title: Item Box
categories.info: *Item boxes hold your items, and are all linked - anything you put in a box can be retrieved from any other box.*

categories.title: Tape Recorder
categories.info: *Used to save the game. On Madhouse difficulty, [Cassette Tapes](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12382) are required to save.*

categories.title: Antique Coin
categories.info: *Antique Coins are used to purchase the items found in bird cages. There are 18 to find on Easy / Normal difficulty, and 33 to find on Madhouse difficulty.*

categories.title: File
categories.info: *Read all 32 files in one playthrough to unlock 'The Devil Is in the Details' achievement.*

categories.title: Handgun Ammo
categories.info:
Used by handguns (namely the [G17 Handgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444712) and [M19 Handgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444839).)

Can also be crafted:
- Handgun Ammo ([Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387) + [Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384)
- Enhanced Handgun Ammo ([Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387) + [Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385))

categories.title: Lockpick
categories.info: *Used to unlock various drawers and toolboxes.*

categories.title: Shotgun Shells
categories.info: Used by the [M37 Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444731) and [M21 Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444823). **Cannot be crafted.**

categories.title: Bomb
categories.info: *Shoot bombs from afar to avoid damage.*

categories.title: Crate
categories.info: *Crates can be smashed to reveal a random item. Look out for crates with less tape than usual - they have bombs inside.*

categories.title: Examinable
categories.info: *Examine this object for extra story, dialogue, or just good old creepy vibes.*
